oaciq_elise.title: Élise - OACIQ Virtual Assistant
oaciq_elise.subtitle: Conversational robot for Quebec real estate brokerage
oaciq_elise.description: Development of an intelligent conversational assistant to accompany real estate brokers and the public in their procedures. Élise answers questions about regulations, buying/selling processes, and guides users to the right OACIQ resources.
oaciq_elise.role: UX designer and conversational experience developer, applying the Calm Magic methodology to create a benevolent and professional interaction.
oaciq_elise.results: 24/7 accessible virtual assistant capable of answering complex regulatory questions, guiding brokers and consumers, and simplifying access to OACIQ services.
oaciq_elise.impact: Significant improvement in accessibility to real estate information for professionals and the public. Reduced waiting time to get answers to common questions.

wuxia_the_fox.title: Wuxia the Fox
wuxia_the_fox.subtitle: Interactive Children's Book & AR Platform
wuxia_the_fox.description: Transmedia educational project launched in Quebec, co-produced with SAGA and public broadcaster TFO. The work takes the form of an illustrated tale associated with an interactive iPad application, combining traditional mythology and modern technologies.
wuxia_the_fox.role: Creator and director of the project, developing augmented narration that mobilizes oral reading and voice recognition.
wuxia_the_fox.results: A 200-page illustrated book with physical modules (masks, wooden blocks to scan) and an iPad app in augmented reality. The device camera recognizes images and symbols from the book to trigger complementary audiovisual animations.
wuxia_the_fox.impact: Funded via successful Kickstarter campaign and published in French and English. Won special mention at Grand Prix Numix 2015 for innovation.

calm_magic_methodology.title: Calm Magic Methodology
calm_magic_methodology.subtitle: Technopoetic Design Framework
calm_magic_methodology.description: Original conceptual framework developed by Jonathan Bélisle to fuse poetry, experience design, and systems thinking in projects. A 'technopoetic' approach aimed at creating transformational digital experiences.
calm_magic_methodology.role: Creator and evangelist of the methodology, applying it across all Paracosm projects.
calm_magic_methodology.results: Comprehensive methodology implemented across all major projects, distinguishing Paracosm's approach in the interactive media landscape.
calm_magic_methodology.impact: Influenced design thinking in Quebec's creative technology sector, providing framework for human-centered innovation.
